nodes.title: Commit verified migration baseline and graph
nodes.goal: Place verified current-state, target-architecture, classification, and execution documents under review.
nodes.failingTest: Not applicable; documentation must not claim unverified behavior.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: All required fields exist, facts cite current evidence, and each implementation node has a rollback path.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Revert the documentation commit; no runtime behavior is changed.

nodes.title: Contain public legacy management surface
nodes.goal: Prevent unauthenticated delivery of a legacy owner-bootstrap and administrative interface.
nodes.failingTest: An unauthenticated management-route contract exposes owner initialization or a client-side `supabase.auth.signUp` path.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: The route no longer exposes Init Owner or browser administrative CRUD; server routing denies or redirects according to a documented retired-route policy.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Revert only the focused containment commit; retain a pre-change deployment alias until the verification window ends.
nodes.blockingReason: Requires Node 24/npm 11 to run the verified local suite.

nodes.title: Remove fail-open website production configuration
nodes.goal: Eliminate dummy Supabase, Payload secret, and database connection values from production code paths.
expectedOutputs: documented local-test escape hatch if justified
nodes.failingTest: Source contract allows an unsafe placeholder to construct a production client or Payload configuration.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Missing required runtime configuration yields an explicit startup/request failure, not a dummy client or predictable secret.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Revert focused commit after confirming deployment environment variables exist; no secret values are committed.

nodes.title: Restrict website administrative data policies and views
nodes.goal: Replace broad authenticated access with tested, least-privilege administrative data access.
prohibitedWritePaths: remote production database without reviewed migration
nodes.failingTest: A generic authenticated identity can read or mutate administrative rows, or an exposed view bypasses intended controls.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Non-admin and anonymous identities are denied; only required roles/actions are granted; views have verified secure behavior; migrations replay from empty state.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Use a reversible migration or restore from the pre-change database backup/point-in-time recovery plan.
nodes.blockingReason: No local Supabase CLI/container database or authorized disposable Supabase environment is currently available.

nodes.title: Implement WorkOS AuthKit and Convex authentication bridge
nodes.goal: Establish validated WorkOS identity from Next.js through Convex.
prohibitedWritePaths: production WorkOS dashboard settings without approval
nodes.failingTest: A protected Convex function cannot distinguish an authenticated WorkOS user from an anonymous caller because no auth configuration/provider exists.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: A valid WorkOS access token yields a Convex identity; missing or invalid identity is denied server-side; preview and production configurations are separated.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Revert the isolated auth bridge commit and disable the preview integration; do not remove existing production website authentication.
nodes.blockingReason: Requires a WorkOS development client ID, API key, callback URLs, secure cookie password, and a non-production Convex deployment.

nodes.title: Create reusable Convex authorization kernel
nodes.goal: Enforce identity, organization, ownership, crew assignment, and privileged permission checks before protected function access.
nodes.failingTest: Anonymous access, cross-organization access, privileged self-assignment, customer foreign-ID access, or crew unassigned-job access succeeds.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Every non-public function validates caller identity and relevant record relation server-side; public intake is explicitly narrow and separate.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Revert the isolated RBAC commit on the preview branch; no production operational route is enabled before tests and smoke checks pass.
nodes.blockingReason: Depends on the active WorkOS/Convex auth bridge.

nodes.title: Port repository integrity and security invariants to platform
nodes.goal: Harden CI without weakening existing checks or invoking untrusted lifecycle scripts.
prohibitedWritePaths: application feature files unrelated to validation
remote ruleset changes before validated PR
nodes.failingTest: Workflow contract accepts a mutable external action ref, missing script reference, or omits required authorization tests.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: The platform has reproducible required checks, immutable external actions, and a CI gate for RBAC tests and Convex validation.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Revert focused workflow contract changes; preserve an emergency manual validation runbook.
nodes.blockingReason: Requires Node 24/npm 11 for verified workflow-equivalent local runs.

nodes.title: Extract reusable agent control plane
nodes.goal: Move reusable orchestration definitions out of product repositories while preserving product-specific governance.
nodes.failingTest: Product package scripts or workflows depend on a removed/moved control-plane path.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Dynamic state and historical handoffs are not committed to product repos; product behavior does not depend on removed paths; reusable definitions have one source of truth.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Keep product adapters pointing to their prior source until reference checks and a migration commit are verified.
nodes.blockingReason: Creation of a new remote repository and extraction policy need a focused review after reference analysis.

nodes.title: Rebuild verified public experience on the platform
nodes.goal: Recreate the rendered public product with canonical primitives and structured Convex content.
nodes.failingTest: Critical public route lacks expected semantic content, responsive behavior, accessibility, or secure intake contract.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Verified user-visible value reaches parity or better without migrating legacy CMS/admin architecture.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Maintain production website as the active origin until platform cutover acceptance is complete.
nodes.blockingReason: Depends on security, CMS, design-system, and asset-inventory foundations.

nodes.title: Validate cutover and rollback readiness
nodes.goal: Ensure secure parity and a tested reversal path before production routing changes.
prohibitedWritePaths: database destructive operations without approved migration
nodes.failingTest: A critical route, authorization boundary, migration reconciliation, or rollback drill is unproven.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: All release gates are green and the old site can be restored within the documented recovery objective.
nodes.rollbackProcedure: Switch traffic back to the protected website deployment and restore the prior platform deployment alias.
nodes.blockingReason: Depends on all security, application, data, and deployment nodes.

externalBlockers.description: The audit environment has Node 22/npm 10 while both repositories require Node 24; the platform additionally declares npm 11.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Install or select the repository-declared Node 24/npm 11 toolchain in the verification environment.

externalBlockers.description: Database policy replay requires a local Supabase stack or authorized disposable project, neither of which is currently configured.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Provide a disposable non-production Supabase project or enable the local Supabase CLI/container stack.

externalBlockers.description: The selected WorkOS/Convex architecture needs development keys, secure cookie configuration, callback URLs, and a non-production Convex deployment.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Configure non-production WorkOS and Convex credentials outside Git and make their identifiers available to the deployment environment.

externalBlockers.description: A separate reusable control-plane repository is a defined target but has not been created or given remote policy settings.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Create the repository with the desired visibility and establish its governance baseline.

externalBlockers.description: Structured Convex CMS schema and authorized publishing flow are not implemented.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Complete an authorized CMS foundation slice.

externalBlockers.description: The canonical shadcn primitive and semantic token layer has not been selected and normalized.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Complete component and token manifest followed by a focused foundation PR.

externalBlockers.description: Website assets, route screenshots, and behavioral inventory have not yet been captured as a verified migration baseline.
Legacy CRM/CMS content mapping and reconciliation rules are not yet implemented.
externalBlockers.unblockCondition: Complete data mapping, dry run, reconciliation, and rollback plan.
